items.text: A failing test shows as one `file:line` line, and the full log is in `/tmp/dshm-*`
A passing run of each wrapper (`scripts/xc build`, `scripts/xc test`, `swift test`, `pnpm test`) writes 20 lines or fewer
A check fails when a demo script or `scripts/review` calls `xcodebuild`, `swift test` or `pnpm test` without a wrapper
